findings: All 26 production-window captures were reviewed individually: 21 main journey images and five draft recovery images. Light and dark views keep messages, controls and keyboard focus readable. At 800 × 680 the Send button wraps to its own visible row.

The saved-history dialog now has one scrolling content body and a reserved Close action. After refused resume, Close at [1097,885, 81,39] is fully inside the dialog [524,231,680,720] and window [224,159,1280,832]. Native pointer Close, reopen, exact retained text and subsequent Resume pass. Focus may scroll the heading partly out of view; selected context and Close remain usable. Saved-message Save and Discard actions are visible in the dedicated recovery capture.

The five draft captures show exact multilingual text, restored source-file selections and clipboard image preview, readable saved status and focus in both appearances. The narrow attachment list scrolls without hiding Add files, Discard or Send. The failed-save view keeps the message editable after refused Quit and presents plain Retry guidance. The journey subsequently verifies that successful Retry clears both save and Quit notices.

The draft receipt passes 59 checks across four launches: native Quit, interrupted exit, native Quit and native Quit. Four named conversations cover two working copies and two providers. A last edit followed by Quit after 30.17 ms reopens intact; 32 rapid native Unicode edits recover the final revision after interruption. Explicit discard remains durable, appearance and reduced motion restore, normal Quit retains each conversation's spending record, and recovery creates no unintended prompt. One explicit send reaches the controlled peer; the API provider receives no post.

The four attachment captures show recognizable image previews, names, sizes, remove controls and a text preview disclosure. The receipt verifies native picker cancellation, 85,216 exact UTF-8/CRLF text bytes, 12,499 exact PNG bytes, clipboard image data and native file-URL drag. Changed files, missing files and unsupported images reach zero provider prompts. Removing the unsupported image sends the original text file once.

Rich views show headings, emphasis, quotes, lists, code, multilingual text and visible link focus. Unsupported pipe-table syntax remains selectable plain text rather than a semantic table. The narrow code pane clips a long line; horizontal code scrolling was not exercised. Authored HTML and unsafe links remain literal text, and the remote image is never requested.

Native selected text stays exactly 'Native selection café 日本語 👩🏽‍💻.' at [474,402,209,17] through stream observations 0, 25 and 46. Latest clears selection and keeps tails 0063 and 0089 at y 636. Reading section 12 stays at [474,402,175,23] while updates advance from 101 to 127. The 130-chunk stream settles; selection proof uses exact clipboard text because AX selection-range arrays are empty.

Copy reply matches 11,321 original UTF-8 bytes, Copy conversation matches 21,660 bytes and tool copying retains complete original fields. Native keyboard link activation opens the controlled localhost destination in Firefox; its request and marker are observed, and only that controlled tab is closed. This does not establish arbitrary external-link behavior.

Known issues remain assigned to native accessibility work: Latest reply covers text in narrow transcript captures and overlaps Copy message in wide attachment captures; Choose model touches the Agent focus ring; unavailable-provider and refused-resume messages expose nested technical error chains. These captures do not claim those issues are resolved.

The main receipt passes 169 checks with seven settled logical histories and 76.36 ms key-to-accessible-reply latency. VoiceOver was not running. The Japanese source delivered Latin 'nihon', so native composition is explicitly unavailable. This run does not establish spoken-reader usability, high-contrast behavior, candidate panels, Romanization, Chinese or Korean input, Linux parity or whole-application performance-budget compliance.
